title: Congress Travel - Isabella
description: R. John meets Isabella, friendly hotel staff, during congress travel check-in.

nodes.text: Isabella stands behind the hotel check-in desk. She's 27, warm smile, flirty eyes. 'Welcome to the Grand Hotel, Senator. We've been expecting you.'

choices.text: Ask if she knows who he is

nodes.text: Isabella: 'You're very welcome. We have you in the presidential suite.' She slides the key card across. 'Anything else I can help you with?'
Isabella: 'Of course! I saw your debate last week. You were... impressive.' She bites her lip slightly.

choices.text: Say he's glad someone appreciated it

nodes.text: Isabella: 'Thank you! I've worked here five years. Best hotel in the city.' She leans forward slightly. 'Though the guests make it even better.'
Isabella: '24 hours. But...' She lowers her voice. 'I can bring something special myself if you prefer. More... personalized service.'

choices.text: Say he'd like that very much
Ask what time she finishes shift

nodes.text: Isabella: 'Of course.' She writes something on a napkin. 'My personal number. For any... special requests.'

choices.text: Take the napkin and thank her

nodes.text: Isabella: 'Most politicians are boring. You're... different.' Her hand brushes yours as she returns your ID.

choices.text: Invite her for a drink later

nodes.text: Isabella: 'The way you handled that journalist. Confident but not arrogant.' She smiles. 'Rare combination.'

choices.text: Say he has many rare qualities
Ask to show her more later

nodes.text: Isabella: 'Exactly! Especially the VIP guests.' She winks. 'Like you.'
Isabella: 'The spa on floor 10. Very private. Or...' She hesitates. 'I could show you the rooftop bar. Best view in the city.'

choices.text: Ask if she joins guests there

nodes.text: Isabella: 'Perfect. I finish at 10. My shift ends, but I can make a special delivery.' She smiles knowingly.
Isabella: '10 PM. But I often stay late for... special guests.' She writes her number on your key card folder.
Isabella: 'Very good.' She leans closer. 'My break is in 20 minutes. Coffee?'
Isabella: 'I'd love that. There's a staff bar downstairs. Very private after 11.'
Isabella: 'I bet.' She finishes the check-in. 'Enjoy your stay, Senator. And... enjoy the city.'

choices.text: Ask if she'll be part of the enjoyment

nodes.text: Isabella: 'I'd like that.' She slides an envelope under the desk. 'My schedule. I'm free most evenings.'

choices.text: Take the envelope and thank her

nodes.text: Isabella: 'Whatever you need, whenever you need it.' Her foot brushes yours under the desk.
Isabella: 'Late check-out, complimentary spa, and...' She lowers her voice. 'Personal concierge service. Me.'
Isabella: 'Great choice. Meet me there at 9? I'll be off shift but I can make an exception.'
Isabella: 'Sometimes. For the right guest.' She smiles. 'I finish at 9. If you're still interested...'
Isabella: 'Call anytime. I'm usually free after 10.' She winks as you walk away.
Isabella: 'Good. Room service will bring the food. I'll bring... dessert.'
Isabella: 'I'll be waiting by the phone.' She smiles as you head to the elevator.
Isabella: 'Staff cafeteria, back corridor. Look for the green door.'
Isabella: 'Perfect. Ask for Isabella at the bar. They'll know.'
Isabella: 'That depends on you, Senator.' She hands you the key. 'Suite 501. Enjoy your stay.'
Inside: her schedule with several evenings circled. 'Those are my favorites,' she whispers.
Isabella: 'Anytime, Senator. Day or night.' She slides a master key under the desk. 'For VIP access.'
Isabella: 'Then it's settled. I'll see you tonight.' She winks.
Isabella: 'See you then, Senator.' She watches you walk away with a smile.
Isabella: 'Then I'll see you at the bar. Don't be late.'

endings.number_exchanged: Isabella gave you her personal number. Low risk, moderate reward.
endings.special_delivery: Isabella will deliver something special to your room. Moderate risk.
endings.shift_ends: Isabella is free after 10. Opportunity for private meeting.
